entries.title: Event detail action layout on narrow desktop widths
Share: add rename support for files and folders
Escalation cards on rehearsal and concert detail pages now let authorized users accept current risk (pausing escalation emails) and reset escalation, with automatic reset when risk profile changes.
Event detail actions now stack vertically on narrower desktop widths to prevent clipped controls in rehearsal and concert headers.
Vote results popover now uses the shared person/contact row layout, fixing broken voter list rendering and improving readability on smaller screens.
Escalation minimums now support configurable combined instrument pairings with shared rehearsal and concert thresholds.
Escalation now sends a follow-up resolved email when an at-risk event returns to a healthy state, including immediate checks after participation or member assignment changes.
Enforce white text on destructive buttons
Shorten mobile search placeholder, keep long desktop
Dark mode white bars in FullCalendar
